# Quantum Multicopy Teleportation

This repository studies correction-free port teleportation with m independent Bell ports and n identical unknown pure d-dimensional input specimens. Fixed-error optimal port order is Theta(d+d^2/n). Stored-channel retrieval inherits the construction, including approximate global return. The lower bound is restricted to port-selection protocols.

## Read by question

- Contract, exact finite bounds, fixed-error theorem and channel application: science/model.md
- Physical Kraus normalization, branch symmetry, Bell moments and joint return: science/construction.md
- Exact Haar score, arbitrary sender instruments and port-only necessity: science/converse.md
- Sender-only projected encoding, QSVT cutoff, known gates and finite precision: science/implementation.md
- Unequal supplies, one-port conditional/unconditional distinction and noisy example: science/examples.md
- Primary comparisons, inherited mechanisms and claim ownership: references/RELATED_WORK.md
- Reproduction commands, actual reports and finite scope: verification/README.md
- Accessible story and learning entrypoint: learning/README.md
- Exactly 30 shared understanding targets, prerequisites and scientific pointers: learning/milestones.md
- Watrous (2018) notation, chapter bridge and missing project-specific steps: learning/anchor.md

The connected scientific route begins at science/README.md. For study, start at learning/README.md, use learning/anchor.md for foundations and follow learning/milestones.md into the authoritative science pages. The README gives a compact entrypoint. Do not infer an unrestricted programmable-processor converse, arbitrary entangled-input channel simulation, indefinite reuse or a hardware runtime advantage.
